body:
Decoded `0x140311f20`, the scoop speed bias, port demand and network allocation. The recovered curves are per update; the remaining questions are below. See [the decode report](https://github.com/Chaoscaot/stormworks-wiki/blob/main/investigation/air-scoop.md) for equations, branch-boundary qualifications and retained evidence.

<!-- stormworks-research-gap:family:part-scoop-intake-2 -->
This issue tracks explicit open questions in the [wiki](https://sw-wiki.maxsp.de/parts/part-scoop-intake-2).

The quotations below preserve the scope of each source. A resource-only article can lack a formula that a separate native-code investigation has partly recovered. Reconcile those findings before treating every quoted item as wholly undecoded.

## Recorded gaps

**Practical behavior guidance**

> The vector subtracted from the point velocity is argument 10 of the fluid update; it is taken to be air velocity because the radiators subtract it for their airflow term, but its source was not traced.

- [wiki/data/behavior.json](https://github.com/Chaoscaot/stormworks-wiki/blob/main/wiki/data/behavior.json), `/families/117/limitations/3`

**Practical behavior guidance**

> Which face of the mesh is local +X, the unit of the speed (the radiator airflow term uses the same velocity), the update rate needed to turn per-update amounts into per-second flow, and what the point sources that lower the factor near them are.

- [wiki/data/behavior.json](https://github.com/Chaoscaot/stormworks-wiki/blob/main/wiki/data/behavior.json), `/families/117/sections/5/body`

## Completion criteria

- Recover the relevant routine or run a reproducible measurement against the identified game build.
- Record equations, units, bounds, assumptions and executable addresses or measurement inputs.
- Update the wiki guidance and its extractor, retaining citations and any remaining uncertainty.
- Add or update an interactive graph when the recovered formula supports one.
- Re-run the relevant source checks and website checks.
title: Air scoop: confirm speed units, placement axis and remaining flow details
